Culture / Landscape — Mandalgre, Meghalaya

Mandalgre Cultural Centre

Location
Mandalgre, Meghalaya
Category
Culture / Landscape
Design role
Ola Magdy, Principal Associate Designer
Practice
Archohm

Overview

A cultural building spanning a planted valley. The elevated form preserves a continuous landscape beneath, while a linking tower and bridge give access to galleries, research spaces and public programmes.

Chapters

  1. 01A bridge across the terrain
  2. 02Programme & accommodation
01

A bridge across the terrain

The project uses the section to connect different levels while retaining the landscape as a continuous surface.

02

Programme & accommodation

Public cultural functions occupy the principal building, with residential accommodation as a related component.
